name: ZONNEBLOEM
source:
A story set at the peak of summer, all about meeting an old friend again after a long time, and realizing you're in love.

[From [url=https://soulsoft.itch.io/zonnebloem]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
盛夏時節，和一個久未謀面的老朋友重逢，然後發現自己戀愛了。這就是這個故事。

[摘自[url=https://soulsoft.itch.io/zonnebloem]itch.io[/url]]
